description: Standard Wet, Dry, and Other waste classification rules for typical urban households.

food_organic.instruction: Compostable. Empty into the green wet-waste bin without plastic wrappers.

garden_waste.instruction: Compostable. Keep free of stones, wires, and plastic ties.

paper.instruction: Recyclable. Keep clean and dry. Avoid if heavily stained with food or grease.

cardboard.instruction: Recyclable. Flatten boxes. Remove plastic tapes and styrofoam before disposal.

plastic_bottle_container.instruction: Recyclable. Empty contents and rinse clean before placing in the dry bin.

plastic_film_flexible.instruction: Recyclable if clean. Bundle flexible wraps together; discard if heavily contaminated.

glass_bottle_jar.instruction: Recyclable. Rinse thoroughly. Wrap broken glass separately in newspaper and mark 'Broken Glass'.

metal_can_tin.instruction: Recyclable. Empty liquid or food residues completely.

textile.instruction: Recyclable/Reusable. Place in textile donation bins or dry recycling if clean.

e_waste.instruction: Special stream. Do not throw in household bins. Hand over at designated e-waste collection points.

battery.instruction: Hazardous waste. Highly flammable and toxic. Drop off at local battery collection stations.

sanitary_medical.instruction: Sanitary/Biomedical waste. Wrap securely in newspaper or red bag. Mark clearly for incineration.

hazardous_chemical.instruction: Hazardous waste. Keep containers tightly closed. Drop off at domestic hazardous waste depots.

mixed_composite_packaging.instruction: Check for local carton/tetra-pak recycling streams. Must be clean and flattened.

unknown_household_item.instruction: Unable to categorize with confidence. Check packaging symbols or choose manually.

background_no_item.instruction: No item clearly detected in center view. Please point camera directly at one item.
